basic_info.description: Discover the updated and versatile floor plan of this beautiful 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home in Portola featuring a bonus room in the back yard, an attached two-car garage, and a private fenced backyard. From vaulted ceilings to a stylish open kitchen with designer countertops and stainless steel appliances, the interior blends modern finishes with a warm, welcoming feel. Recessed lighting and large windows create a bright, airy flow through the living room, dining area, and kitchen. Down the hallway, you'll find a full bathroom and two spacious bedrooms. The primary suite includes an attached bonus room overlooking the backyardperfect for a home office or creative studio - as well as an ensuite bathroom. The lower level offers exceptional flexibility, with access to storage, the attached garage with laundry, and a separate 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom bonus suite. This space features its own entrance, a custom wet bar with built-in cabinetry and sink, 2 large bedrooms, and a bathroom with stall shower. Enjoy a private, fully fenced yard with space for outdoor dining, a BBQ setup, and direct access to the attached bonus roomideal for use as a gym, office, studio, or guest space. Just minutes from the restaurants and shops with easy access to 101 and 280 for a smooth commute.
